metadata.description: Heyra demo marketplace: five plugins for non-developers in Claude Chat and Claude Cowork (marketing, email, meetings, partner sales, back office) and one developer plugin for Claude Code and GitHub Copilot. All content is about Heyra, a fictional Danish betting and gaming operator.

plugins.name: heyra-marketing
plugins.description: Marketing and communications for Heyra, a fictional Danish betting and gaming operator. Brand voice in Danish and English, campaign briefs, social posts, press releases, and a compliance check against Danish gambling-marketing rules (18+, StopSpillet, ROFUS, bonus limits). Skills work in Claude Chat and Cowork; the brand-compliance reviewer subagent runs in Cowork.

plugins.name: heyra-email
plugins.description: Email handling for Heyra employees in their own Outlook inbox - triage by urgency and action, replies drafted in your voice, thread summaries and a list of open follow-ups. Knows the house email style, GDPR rules for player data, and which mails to redirect (players, self-exclusion requests, press, retailers). Works in Claude Chat and Cowork with the Microsoft 365 connector, or with pasted text.

plugins.name: heyra-meetings
plugins.description: Meetings at Heyra - a one-page prep from calendar, mail and last minutes; minutes with decisions and actions from notes or a transcript; an action tracker with reminders; and a weekly status report. Follows the Heyra minutes standard and keeps player data out of documents. Works in Claude Chat and Cowork with Microsoft 365, optionally with a transcription service.

plugins.name: heyra-sales
plugins.description: Partner sales for Heyra - retail partners, sponsorships and B2B agreements. Account research one-pagers, offers from the partner playbook, follow-up emails after meetings, and a weekly pipeline review with honest forecasting. Knows what Heyra may and may not offer partners under Danish gambling rules. Works in Claude Chat and Cowork with Microsoft 365 and a CRM connector.

plugins.name: heyra-back-office
plugins.description: Finance, HR and legal admin for Heyra in one plugin - invoice checks with approval routing, the travel and expense policy, job descriptions and onboarding plans with the mandatory trainings, policy lookup from the employee handbook, contract summaries with red flags, and GDPR data-subject requests with deadlines and retention rules. Works in Claude Chat and Cowork with Microsoft 365 and Jira or Confluence.

plugins.name: heyra-dev
plugins.description: Developer plugin for Heyra engineers, installable in Claude Code, GitHub Copilot CLI, VS Code and the Copilot cloud agent. /commit, /pr-description, /review-changes, /doctor and /setup skills, TDD guidance, code-reviewer and test-writer subagents (Claude and Copilot formats), guard-rail hooks, Python and TypeScript language servers, and Context7 plus Playwright MCP servers. Ships both the Claude plugin manifest and the Agent Plugins 1.0 manifest.
